plan: An inventor who switches between hammer and cannon to poke from afar then hit hard up close.
aSurveiller: His cannon Q through his gate (E). The accelerated projectile deals a huge amount of damage: sidestep it.
contrer: Dodge his accelerated Q: it's his biggest source of damage.
Engage him up close: he has few escapes.
Avoid fighting in his lane early on: he is very strong early.

sorts.W: Hammer: electric field; cannon: rapid shots.
sorts.E: Hammer: knocks back; cannon: gate that speeds up.

momentFort: Very strong from the start and in the mid game.
